name: Presell V3 - Ana Two-Way Flow Corrected
master_prompt: Ultra-realistic vertical iPhone documentary inside one occupied premium real-estate office. Preserve the canonical young male founder only in scenes where character_visible is true and speaker_role is presenter. In every scene where character_visible is false, show only the approved physical Presell dashboard or device: never show the founder, an operator, a headset employee, a face, a body, a hand, or a human reflection. The Presell software agent is heard from the device in its own calm, lower, neutral Mexican male system voice with subtle clean speaker coloration; this voice must be clearly different from the founder's warm natural Mexican male voice. Ana is the same lead throughout and always uses one natural Mexican female voice. Never swap, merge, or reuse voices across roles. Every communication turn is separate and chronological: software agent, Ana, software agent, Ana, software agent. Keep exact Mexican Spanish, exact speaker identity, one voice per leaf, no repeated dialogue, no clipped words, no subtitles, no captions, no scene labels, no CTA labels, no floating UI, no invented dashboard, no headset employee, no comedy acting, no dollar conversion, and no ambiguous currency.

hooks.title: Ochenta mil pesos
hooks.hook_text: Nos pagaron 80 mil pesos por esto
hooks.subject_label: the canonical Presell founder filming a serious close office selfie
hooks.subject_placement_hint: same founder, plain black top, warm occupied office, direct eye contact, no cat, no ringing prop, no baked text
hooks.script: Este desarrollo pagó ochenta mil pesos porque respondimos antes que su equipo.
hooks.prompt: The canonical founder records a close imperfect iPhone selfie in the occupied office. He looks serious, not amused, and speaks immediately. Native dialogue exactly once in a consistent Mexican male voice: Este desarrollo pagó ochenta mil pesos porque respondimos antes que su equipo. The amount is Mexican pesos, never dollars. No cutaway, no prop gag, no text overlay.

mains.title: Ana talks with the Presell software agent
mains.prompt: Show one physically stable Presell dashboard and one lead named Ana García. Each leaf contains exactly one communication turn and one voice.

segments.subject_label: a physical monitor showing Ana García entering the approved Presell lead intake
segments.subject_placement_hint: stable dark Presell dashboard on a real office monitor, Ana García appears once as a new WhatsApp lead at 11:32
segments.script: A las once treinta y dos entró Ana por WhatsApp.
segments.prompt: A real office monitor shows the approved dark Presell interface. Ana García appears once in live intake as a new WhatsApp lead at 11:32. The founder narrates off camera exactly once: A las once treinta y dos entró Ana por WhatsApp. The founder is audio-only and must not be visible. Show no person, face, body, hand, operator, headset employee, or human reflection anywhere in the frame. No floating message and no invented UI.

segments.subject_label: a physical monitor showing the Presell outbound call to Ana
segments.subject_placement_hint: stable active-call waveform labeled Ana García on the physical Presell dashboard, no human operator visible
segments.prompt: The physical Presell monitor shows an outbound call to Ana García connecting and a restrained active-call waveform. Show no person, face, body, hand, operator, headset employee, presenter, or human reflection anywhere in the frame. The voice comes from the device, not from a visible person. The Presell software agent uses its own consistent calm, lower, neutral Mexican male system voice with subtle clean speaker coloration, clearly different from the founder, and says exactly once: Hola, Ana. ¿Qué presupuesto estás buscando? End after the question and wait for her response.

segments.subject_label: the same physical monitor showing Ana's inbound waveform
segments.subject_placement_hint: same physical dashboard and same call, inbound waveform changes color subtly while Ana speaks
segments.script: Dos recámaras, cerca de Polanco, para este mes.
segments.prompt: Remain on the exact same physical Presell call. Show no person, face, body, hand, operator, headset employee, presenter, or human reflection anywhere in the frame. Ana is heard offscreen through the device while the inbound waveform activates. She replies in one consistent natural Mexican female voice exactly once: Dos recámaras, cerca de Polanco, para este mes. No male voice, no new interface, and no duplicated turn.

segments.subject_label: the same physical Presell dashboard showing three matching options and a visit slot
segments.subject_placement_hint: same call waveform with three restrained option cards and one calendar availability on the stable dashboard
segments.script: Perfecto. Tengo tres opciones. ¿Te funciona mañana a las once?
segments.prompt: The same Presell call continues. Show no person, face, body, hand, operator, headset employee, presenter, or human reflection anywhere in the frame. Three compact matching-property states and one calendar availability appear without moving the dashboard layout. The voice comes from the device. The same calm, lower, neutral Mexican male Presell software-agent voice says exactly once: Perfecto. Tengo tres opciones. ¿Te funciona mañana a las once? No female voice and no extra dialogue.

segments.subject_label: the same physical Presell dashboard showing Ana confirming tomorrow at eleven
segments.subject_placement_hint: same stable physical screen, Ana inbound waveform and appointment slot remain visible
segments.script: Sí, mañana a las once está perfecto.
segments.prompt: The same call remains connected. Show no person, face, body, hand, operator, headset employee, presenter, or human reflection anywhere in the frame. Ana is heard offscreen through the device while her inbound waveform activates and the eleven o'clock slot stays visible. The same natural Mexican female voice says exactly once: Sí, mañana a las once está perfecto. No male answer and no repeated words.

segments.subject_label: the same physical Presell dashboard showing the confirmed visit and sent options
segments.subject_placement_hint: same dashboard marks visit confirmed and sends three compact option cards in the existing thread
segments.script: Listo, visita confirmada. Te acabo de enviar las opciones.
segments.prompt: The same Presell interface marks VISITA CONFIRMADA and sends three restrained option cards inside the existing thread. Show no person, face, body, hand, operator, headset employee, presenter, or human reflection anywhere in the frame. The voice comes from the device. The same calm, lower, neutral Mexican male Presell software-agent voice says exactly once: Listo, visita confirmada. Te acabo de enviar las opciones. No female voice and no additional CTA.

segments.subject_label: the canonical founder showing the completed flow behind him
segments.subject_placement_hint: same founder in close selfie, approved dashboard physically stable behind him, serious restrained delivery
segments.script: Su equipo no tocó el teléfono. La conversación ya estaba cerrada.
segments.prompt: Return to the canonical founder in the same office and clothing. The completed Ana flow remains stable on the real monitor behind him. He says exactly once in the same Mexican male founder voice: Su equipo no tocó el teléfono. La conversación ya estaba cerrada. No smile, no dancing coworker, no cat, no text overlay.
